correctness.rationale: The local clique argument proves automatic totality. The tight lower bound follows from z<=n and z<=3t. Explicit centers separated two or three columns construct optimum labelings for all n, with the C3 obstruction separately proved. At n=3q, equality requires exactly q twos covering all 3q zeros without overlaps, forcing a unique path tiling or three cycle phases; proper defender-row colorings give the exact count. The standalone checker separately validates 936 graph witnesses, 20 unrestricted exact DP optima/counts, and four full enumerations. Finite tests are not relied on as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Counting and classifying every minimum labeling is a motivated structural refinement of studied minimum-weight outer-independent Roman parameters, not an arbitrary statistic. The proof exposes rigid triple-column packing and a cyclic chromatic-polynomial correction. It gives complete infinite families in two geometries and all clique widths; it does not claim counts at other residues.
